# Locality Guide: Câmara de Lobos, Madeira, Portugal (1851–1940)

## Jurisdiction overview
- **Formed:** Municipality established 25 May 1835 by ministerial decree. Parish of São Sebastião has records from 1570.
- **County seat:** Câmara de Lobos town
- **Parent jurisdiction:** Madeira Islands Autonomous Region, Portugal
- **Economy:** Fishing, viticulture (Madeira wine), sugarcane, subsistence agriculture; high emigration to Hawaii, Brazil, and North America in this period.
- **Religious denominations:** Roman Catholic, overwhelmingly.

## Boundary changes
Stable since 1835 formation. Six civil parishes each maintain separate registers: São Sebastião (town), Estreito de Câmara de Lobos, Curral das Freiras, Quinta Grande, Jardim do Mar, Campanário.

## Available record types

### Vital records (civil registration)
- 1832: Registration of non-Catholics required (municipal level)
- 1878: Universal civil registration at municipal level; Catholic priests also functioned as civil registrars
- 1911: Fully mandatory for all; priests ceased civil registration role
Deaths for the full 1851-1940 period are now at the Regional Archive of Madeira (transferred after 30 years).

### Church records
Primary source before 1878, parallel source to 1910. Key FamilySearch collection: Portugal, Madeira, Catholic Church Records, 1044-1990 (collection 4426199). Parish death volumes for Câmara de Lobos town (São Sebastião) are present from at least 1853, most 75-96% name-indexed on FamilySearch.

### Emigration/passport records
Madeira Passport Registers 1872-1910: free at abm.madeira.gov.pt/pesquisa/passaportes and indexed at Ancestry. Hawaii passenger manifests 1843-1900: free at Digital Collections Hawaii. Hamburg passenger lists 1850-1934: FamilySearch and Ancestry.

### Civil registration access
Tombo.pt (tombo.pt/en/d/madeira): browsable images, incomplete. Arquivo da Madeira database (abm.madeira.gov.pt): name-searchable. FamilySearch collection 4426199: indexed + images.

## Repository guide
- **Online:** FamilySearch (collection 4426199, free), Arquivo da Madeira (free), Tombo.pt (free), Ancestry/MyHeritage/FindMyPast (subscription)
- **Physical:** Arquivo Regional e Biblioteca Pública da Madeira, Caminho dos Álamos n.º 35, 9020-064 Funchal; abm.sretc@madeira.gov.pt; +351 291 708 400
- **FamilySearch Center:** Funchal Portugal FamilySearch Center, Rua Tenente Coronel Sarmento 25, Funchal 9000-020; PT_Funchal@familyhistorymail.org

## Records NOT online
Civil death registrations 1911-1940, notarial records, tax records, cemetery sexton records, post-1910 ecclesiastical records, Easter duty rolls.

## Research tips
- Search FamilySearch collection 4426199 by name first for parish death registers.
- Search all six parishes, not just the town parish.
- Check Madeira Passport Registers before assuming death in Madeira.
- Write requests to the Regional Archive in Portuguese.
- 631 total death/vital volumes match this place and period on FamilySearch; the first page (~100 volumes) was reviewed — additional volumes for 1889-1940 exist.
